faqs.question: Why does the app say "At least one forage is required"?
faqs.answer: Every diet needs at least one feed of type Forage. Add one on Feed Selection and generate again.

faqs.question: The report says no diet was found. What can I do?
faqs.answer: Add more feeds, check the prices and loosen any limits you set. The topic shows each step.

faqs.question: My report shows "PDF Pending".
faqs.answer: The PDF is made in the background after you save. Open Feed Reports again after a minute.

faqs.question: How do I contact the RationSmart team?
faqs.answer: Open Menu, then Help & Support, then Contact Us.
